snippet.title: Idle Ants - tiny adventure, BIG FUN!
snippet.description:
Idle ants is an amazingly new game from Madbox, where you grow a super colony of ants! With fun features like upgrading your ants strength, you can watch them eat everything.

Think you've got what it takes to lead your ant kingdom? Idle Ants is now available on the App Store and google Play - https://smarturl.it/antlife
